CDR Native Engine

This folder is reserved for the Android native CDR engine.

Architecture:

CDR file
   ↓
libcdr
   ↓
SVG / Object Model
   ↓
Urdu Design Studio Editor

Required native dependencies:
- libcdr
- librevenge
- ICU
- lcms2
- zlib
- Boost

The native engine will be integrated through Android NDK/CMake.
